_meta.notes: WORTH A HUMAN LOOK: this 4-page filing contains NO plain "Summary Page" - page 2 is the "Summary Page / Other Campaign Accounts" variant (its Column B header reads "Year to Date", not "Aggregate Total"), and pages 3-4 are Schedule A and Schedule B, both marked NONE with slashed-O totals. The figures recorded here come from that Other-Campaign-Accounts summary page, which the filer used as his only summary. Lines 3 and 4 carry strike-throughs: on Line 3 a slashed O was struck and "25.00" survives; on Line 4 a slashed O was struck and "25.00" was written (although Line 4 is supposed to copy Line 1 Column A, which is 0). Cents are raised superscripts. Neither amendment box is checked. Handwritten under the general-election checkbox: "DUE NOV 1 (TUESDAY)".
